==Quest information==

===Objectives===
*Enter the [[Tunnels of the Forsaken]].
*Ignite the first pyre. 3 remaining. Hold off the waves of furious spirits.
*Ignite the second pyre. 2 remaining. Hold off the waves of furious spirits.
*Ignite the third pyre. 1 remaining. Hold off the waves of furious spirits.
*Speak with Ghost of Althea in the ruined village.

===Reward===
*500 [[Experience]]
* 100 {{gold}}

==Walkthrough==
It is advised to bring a full party, as well as skills and weapons dealing [[holy damage]]. This quest can be difficult with henchmen and not enough firepower, as the spawning rate of the [[Furious Ghost]]s is high and they attack from various angles, making [[AoE]] spells less effective. The henchmen are also quite frail meaning that keeping them alive for the pyre part can be tedious.

Follow the quest marker after entering the area (the left path is a dead end anyway). Walk towards the three pyres indicated on the map. To ignite a pyre, simply stand close to it (a charging bar will appear) until the quest updates and flames appear; no particular item is needed. 

Entering the range of a pyre will initiate the spawning of Furious Ghosts, which will run towards the pyre until it is ignited. The rate at which the bar progresses depends on the difference between the number of party members in range minus the number of foes.

[[Blunted Spirit|Blunted]], [[Fractured Spirit|Fractured]], and [[Withered Spirit]]s are encountered on the path. They will not respawn unlike the Furious Ghosts. It is recommended to make sure the area is clear of them before entering the pyre's area, as the continuously respawning Furious Ghosts in addition can easily overwhelm the group. If the party lacks the damage to clear the Furious Ghosts quickly enough, one can attempt to tank them outside of the pyre range while some party member stands in the capture zone. Once the pyre has been ignited, the remaining Furious Ghosts will despawn.

Once all three pyres are ignited, return to [[Ghost of Althea]] near the middle pyre to accept the reward.

==Dialogue== 
===Initial dialogue=== 
;Ghost of Althea
:''"I can hear the cries of so many aggrieved spirits, lost like myself until very recently. They call out for help from the very ground beneath our feet.''

:''This war has stolen countless lives. Many of the fallen were not soldiers, but regular people who sought only to live regular existences. To raise families and pursue passions. To be happy, to be safe. The Searing and the war that followed have torn asunder so many dreams.''

:''Many of these spirits retreated underground, to the place the living now call the '''Tunnels of the Forsaken'''. There the spirits wander, malcontent and desperate for a way to escape the scorched battlefields they once knew as home.''

:''Will you aid me in granting those spirits peace and passage from this wicked world?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I will help calm the spirits of the dead.
| decline = I'm needed on the warfront.
| ask = I was but one of countless victims whose life was stolen by the violent ambitions of Charr and man. I hear the voices of so many crying out from the earth itself. I implore you: guide these spirits towards the peace they deserve!
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;After igniting the third pyre
:'''Ghost of Althea:''' ''"I sense the fear and pain in this area lifting... Come speak with me over here."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Ghost of Althea
:''"You have done a great service to these poor spirits. May they find peaceful passage to the Mists.''

:''For all the dead fallen victim to this war, there are as many living refugees yet clinging to hope. While [[Prince Rurik]] and [[King Adelbern]] feud over military tactics and politics, many Ascalonians seek only to carve out a place beyond the violence of war, where families can be safe, where lives can be lived rather than sacrificed.''

:''I venture to say that these departed spirits have done us a service in turn. For they have led us here, to this ancient village. We shall make of this place a haven for our brothers and sisters, living and dead, in need of a place to lay their heads.''

:''I hope you'll return and visit us, friend."''

===Dialogue after accepting reward===
;Ghost of Althea
:''"These tunnels provide a haven from the war above. For now, I will do what I can to help these people carve out a living.''

:''We are expecting a shipment of supplies that has not yet arrived. If you're traveling that way, can you check in with [[Kopp the Quick]] in [[Piken Square]] and see when we can expect those supplies?"''

==Notes==
* Only level 1 of [[Tunnels of the Forsaken]] will be accessible while this quest is active.
** Further enemies like [[Bandit]]s, [[Grawl]] and [[Elemental]]s will also spawn as usual, but are not encountered on the quest's path.
